data.title: Document Metadata Anomaly — AI-Generated ID Document Detection
data.description: Detects submitted identity documents with metadata inconsistencies indicating AI generation or manipulation: PDF creation tools (Photoshop, GIMP, AI generators), timestamp manipulation (creation date after modification date), inconsistent DPI, missing EXIF data, font embedding anomalies. 85% of synthetic fraud now involves GenAI document fabrication. Underground services like OnlyFake and ProKYC produce photo-realistic government IDs for as little as $30, complete with simulated holograms and barcode data, but leave detectable metadata and structural artifacts that differ from genuine document scans.

detection.condition: selection_document_submission AND (filter_ai_score OR (filter_metadata_anomaly) OR filter_timestamp_anomaly OR filter_dpi_inconsistency OR filter_font_anomaly)

enrichment_required.source: AI forgery detection model — probability score (0-1) indicating AI generation
PDF metadata extraction — Creator field from document properties
EXIF metadata analysis — boolean indicating presence of camera EXIF data
PDF metadata extraction — document creation timestamp
PDF metadata extraction — document last modified timestamp
Image analysis — boolean indicating consistent DPI across document regions
Font analysis — boolean indicating anomalous font embedding patterns

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for AI-Generated ID Document Detection")`
`comment("Detects document submissions with metadata indicating AI generation")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
  event_type="DOCUMENT_SUBMISSION"
| eval anomaly_type = case(
    document_ai_score > 0.7, "high_ai_score",
    match(pdf_creator, "Photoshop|GIMP|Stable Diffusion|Midjourney|DALL-E|unknown_ai_generator")
      AND exif_data_present="false", "suspicious_creator_no_exif",
    pdf_creation_date > pdf_modification_date, "timestamp_manipulation",
    dpi_consistency_check="false", "dpi_inconsistency",
    font_embedding_anomaly="true", "font_anomaly",
    1=1, "none")
| where anomaly_type != "none"
| table applicant_id, submission_timestamp, document_type,
        document_ai_score, pdf_creator, exif_data_present,
        dpi_consistency_check, font_embedding_anomaly,
        anomaly_type, device_fingerprint, ip_address
| sort - submission_timestamp
queries.sql:
-- SQL for AI-Generated ID Document Detection
-- Detects document submissions with metadata indicating AI generation
SELECT
  d.applicant_id,
  d.submission_timestamp,
  d.document_type,
  e.document_ai_score,
  e.pdf_creator,
  e.exif_data_present,
  e.dpi_consistency_check,
  e.font_embedding_anomaly,
  CASE
    WHEN e.document_ai_score > 0.7 THEN 'high_ai_score'
    WHEN e.pdf_creator IN ('Photoshop', 'GIMP', 'Stable Diffusion', 'Midjourney', 'DALL-E', 'unknown_ai_generator')
         AND e.exif_data_present = 0 THEN 'suspicious_creator_no_exif'
    WHEN e.pdf_creation_date > e.pdf_modification_date THEN 'timestamp_manipulation'
    WHEN e.dpi_consistency_check = 0 THEN 'dpi_inconsistency'
    WHEN e.font_embedding_anomaly = 1 THEN 'font_anomaly'
  END AS anomaly_type,
  d.device_fingerprint,
  d.ip_address
FROM document_submissions d
JOIN document_enrichment e ON d.document_file_hash = e.document_file_hash
WHERE d.event_type = 'DOCUMENT_SUBMISSION'
  AND (
    e.document_ai_score > 0.7
    OR (e.pdf_creator IN ('Photoshop', 'GIMP', 'Stable Diffusion', 'Midjourney', 'DALL-E', 'unknown_ai_generator')
        AND e.exif_data_present = 0)
    OR e.pdf_creation_date > e.pdf_modification_date
    OR e.dpi_consistency_check = 0
    OR e.font_embedding_anomaly = 1
  )
ORDER BY d.submission_timestamp DESC

references: Entrust 2025 Identity Fraud Report — 311% increase in AI-generated document fraud
LexisNexis Risk Solutions, Global State of Fraud and Identity Report 2026
Trend Micro, Underground KYC Bypass Market Research
falsepositives: Legitimate documents that were scanned using software that strips EXIF data
Documents re-saved or compressed by institution systems altering metadata
Older documents digitized with inconsistent scanning settings across pages
